scope: stops used by trips that serve at least one stop in Bern municipality

kinds.edge: stop_id is an atlas boarding-edge SLOID
kinds.edge_sector_variant: generated stop_id (<station>_gen:<edge>_pf:<sectors>); original_stop_id is the atlas edge SLOID
kinds.edge_by_designation: edge id unknown to atlas today; matched by platform_code = designation (inferred)
kinds.edge_unresolved: edge id unknown to atlas today and no unique designation match; resolves to the station only
kinds.station: stop_id is the station (service point) SLOID, no edge assigned in the timetable
kinds.station_not_in_atlas: foreign station without Swiss SLOID; DiDok/UIC number only
kinds.parent_station: location_type=1 parent record (never referenced by stop_times)

stops.inferred_how: GTFS platform_code equals the atlas designation of exactly one edge of the same station
